text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Oh-ho? Fancy meeting you here, Rose-chan~
Headed back from an outing with
Trainer-chan?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Yes, are the two of you heading out somewhere
as well?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
We're just about to have dinner.
Say, why don't you and your friends join us,
Rose-chan?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Word is that Tran-san's favorite spot is
serving up a special menu that only comes
once a year.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I tell ya, Acu-san is just amazing.
She's always so full of adventurous
spirit~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I mean,
some people just straight-up can't stomach
it.
...Insect cuisine, that is.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: ...What did you just say?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh my! Rose-chan,
you don't do well with bugs?
Well then, no need to push yourself, dear.
I'm sorry for asking you without knowing.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just like Accu-san says!
We'll save dining with Rose-chan for next
time as something to look forward to!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
There's this new fusion French place I've
been super curious about.
How's that sound?
choice_data_list: Lady Rose, for today, perhaps we s...

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...No.
As the one who will eventually lead the Clan
of Roses,
it is something I must face sooner or
later.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Though it may be somewhat drastic...
let us take this opportunity to overcome
it.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Well, well, order placed~♪
I wonder what'll turn up this year.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I was looking forward to this so much,
I haven't eaten a bite since morning~!
So if there's any leftovers,
pass 'em my way, okay?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
How dependable.
Thank you for your consideration.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Even so, it is quite bustling—
is entomophagy truly a commonplace practice
among the populace?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I suppose it's not what you'd call
typical, no.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Even so,
people in mountain regions have long eaten
them
simmered in soy sauce or candied,
you know?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
After all,
they were a precious source of protein that
could
be gathered even in regions where fish and
meat were scarce.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see, so it is a traditional local dish.
In that case,
I shall cast aside all preconceptions and—

text_block_list.name: Store Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for waiting~!
Here is your special-course insect feast!

Lined up before us was an array of dishes
cooked whole in their original forms—
a collection of visually striking creations,
to say the least.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
........................How profoundly
fascinating.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha.
I mean,
that's kind of the best part about it~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Though honestly,
I ate it with my eyes squeezed shut at first
too.
Why not give it a try, Rose-chan?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
No, presentation is also
a vital element of cuisine.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Only when one savors every last drop of the
artisan's intent poured into it—

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Good on ya,
Rose-chan. I oughta give thanks
for the life given, too,
and savor every bite.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Indeed. To achieve that, we must first—

Deftly wielding her knife and fork,
Rose Kingdom
began peeling the shell with pristine,
fluid grace.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
My, my, aren't you nimble? You use your
knife and fork so very well, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I simply lacked the confidence to keep my
hands pristine without a finger bowl,
you see.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I resolved to partake of it in the same
manner
as one would a crustacean like
langoustine.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
...Now then,
the preparations are complete.
Shall we partake in the meal?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: This is...!

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... impressive.
I didn't think you'd actually finish the
whole thing.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Dishes crafted with true ingenuity—
I have savored every single one.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that was so savory and delicious.
This'd make a mighty fine snack with tea♪

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Right,
right?! That contrast with how it looks
is just irresistible~

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I see.
One must not be misled by appearances,
but discern the true essence within—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
So the chef infused this dish with such a
message.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I can only feel ashamed of harboring such
preconceptions...
I still have much discipline yet to
attain.
choice_data_list: Not at all, it was truly splendid.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, that goes for you too, Trainer-san.
Good on you for cleaning your plate, dear.
choice_data_list: Thank you for the delicious meal.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Personally, I kinda wanted to see a fresher,
first-time reaction, though~.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
If you grimace at the dish placed before
you,
you are hardly fit to serve as the Rose
Clan's Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: Would you not agree, Trainer?

Overcoming these trials together,
I felt as though my bond with Rose Kingdom
had deepened.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
Invaluable... indeed.
It was an experience I could never have had
on my own.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
My sincere thanks to you both.
You have broadened my horizons immensely.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu,
if you ever feel like having a thrilling
experience,
just let me know anytime, 'kay?♪
